note: What a server sends to say how many uses one of a unit's spells has left and when the next returns. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: summonerSpell
fields.note: Whether the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

fields.name: mostCharges
fields.note: How many charges the slot can hold: any value below zero, -1 among them, keeps the spell's own figure for its level; 0 has the slot use no charges; anything above zero is that many.

fields.name: rechargeFor
fields.note: How long the next use has been coming back, in seconds.

fields.name: rechargeTime
fields.note: How long a use takes to come back, in seconds.
